clip_key: # Example lines for your own probe lineset 'pip', see example_lineset.cfg. Put a file like this in GameData/<YourMod>/Lonapse/Probe/
# (or in GameData/Lonapse/Phrases/Extra/ for your own game) and restart KSP. The format is that of Phrases/Extra.
# core is the name of your LONAPSE_PROBE_LINES node. A scene is one exchange: Mission Control (role mc), the probe (role probe).
# The probe has no voice, only a subtitle like [beeps happily] and a beep mood: happy offended curious scared sleepy proud bored.
# Mission Control has no recording here. The runtime voice (Piper) speaks the spanish column, or spanish_rt when it is there.
# {probe} is the name of the probe in the subtitle. It goes in the english and in spanish_rt, never in the spanish column.
# Without the runtime voice Mission Control shows its subtitle only. New clip keys: start with a prefix of your own, here px_pip_.
